pencil-47.$description:

pen-58.$description:
Req for: regular text, inverted backgrounds
AA standard body text on every paper and chalk of every family
Theming: tints carry neutral hue (gray); re-solved to clear its floor

pen-70.$description:
Req for: heavy-emphasis text, inverted backgrounds
AA standard body text on every paper and chalk of every family
Theming: tints carry neutral hue (gray); re-solved to clear its floor

pen-100.$description:
Req for: max-emphasis text
AA standard body text on every paper and chalk of every family

stamp-0.$description:
Req for: CTAs, the fill at rest
Use: primary button fills; optional for avatars, badges and other elements that carry text. Not a standalone color: it has no contrast guarantee of its own, only its on-text has one. Use it alone or with the two steps above it. Always bordered with its edge
Theming: fully re-solved per theme and family (gray)

stamp-1.$description:
Req for: CTAs, the fill one step from rest
Use: the fill one step from rest, with the fill at rest; for nothing else. Always bordered with the edge
Theming: follows the fill at rest (gray)

stamp-2.$description:
Req for: CTAs, the fill two steps from rest
Use: the fill two steps from rest, with the fill at rest; for nothing else. Always bordered with the edge
Theming: follows the fill at rest (gray)

stamp-edge.$description:
Req for: min APCA visibility
Use: the border of the fill at every step, always rendered with it and never without it (it resolves to transparent unless the fill sits close to the page); for nothing else
Theming: draws for CTAs that sit close to the page; strength per family tier (gray)

stamp-on.$description:
Req for: text over the CTA color
AA standard body text over its CTA
Use: the only text color over the fill at every step; never elsewhere
Theming: whichever pole passes; quiet CTAs take the soft pole (gray)
